title: AMD Ryzen 5 9600X 6-Core, 12-Thread CPU US$163.88 (~A$238.13) Delivered @ Tech PC Store AliExpress
body:
Deal: AMD Ryzen 5 9600X 6-Core, 12-Thread CPU US$163.88 (~A$238.13) Delivered @ Tech PC Store AliExpress

[poiterbad] I was about to buy this through Amazon for $302. Is buying CPUs through AliExpress trusted enough to save that $60?
[SavingUpForAnXbox] I bought a 7800x3D a few months back and it's performed above expectation, highly recommend.
[Domingo] Are you overclocking it? Or were your expectations too high? CPU performance is very well specified based on the model you are purchasing
[SavingUpForAnXbox] Kept it at base and compared it to about 5 other Cinebench scores and performed better than most.
[ReaperX22] Got my 7800X3D also from AE Aug last year (yay for buying my RAM a month before rampocolypse!) - you can determine the authenticity via https://www.amd.com/en/resources/support-articles/faqs/SNV-L…
Mine showed up just fine (as an OEM model, of course); but they're legit chips.
I would say: it depends. 60 bucks isn't a LOT of savings.. In my case it was a 200+ dollar difference vs local. For 50-60 bucks, personally I'd probably buy local (but I mean.. local, not amazon, get it from ya local PC store or whatever along with whatever else you need kinda thing).. Easier warranty all that.
I tend to only look to AE when I can save big % amounts. I.e my dreame vacuum spare parts were 30 bucks (still oem!) from AE, vs 90-100 local.
[ilikegengar] I have bought close to a dozen cpu from Aliexpress and they have all performed fine.
Just think about it, even the worst modern day cpu are lasting 10 years nowadays. Chances of it dying on you is slim to none. Only thing to really watch out for is counterfeit, which when posted by someone trusted like Clear, is pretty legit. Worst case scenario and something happens, Aliexpress also has pretty good customer service.
[AreYouAWiiizard] It's quite a bit more than $60 when you include cashback…
[Captainbirdseye] Not worth it in my experience. I just had my 7900x die (no pun) after 13 months. They didn't want to know.
AMD doesn't provide warranty on OEM tray CPUs either
[HandsomeMonkey] How do you kill a CPU? I've been using PC since the 90s and not one CPU died on me. I ended up giving away the old PCs and built a new one every once in a blue moon.
[oliularnob18] I have also bought 7800x3d from aliexpress working great so far.
[tastycrayon] Got Ryzen 7 9700x during last sale for usd 200 from this guys.
